subject: Hook Horror
picture: A hook horror stands in a dungeon hall. Vulture bony head and beak. Each arm ends in one large curved hook made of bone, not a held sword, not a weapon with a handle. Thick plated beetle body, two legs, clawed feet. Empty hands except those fused hooks. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages.
